notes.title: Steam Next Fest | Demo Update
notes.content:
A warm welcome to all the new players joining us as part of the Steam Next Fest! 🚀 We monitor your feedback closely and have already implemented the first batch of improvements! Many of you have asked for additional language support, and we are happy to announce that the demo has received an update that addresses these requests! The game is now available in:
[list][*] French
[*] German
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese[/list]
📝 We want to hear your impressions: share your thoughts in reviews as well as in our communities on Steam or Discord, and this will help us make the game even better!

notes.title: FLASHOUT 3 is now OUT!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello all Jujubee fans![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6106540/5c0dcc32c2114159e6b1479782654d88882756ec.gif[/img]

Before we share with you some new info on Dark Moon, which has been in development the whole time (even though we didn't share anything for a while - but no worries, it's in full production), we would also like to inform you about another project, that was being developed by our second team - FLASHOUT 3. And we are delighted to inform, that the game is [b]now live on Steam! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288247/d7497eacc9e2ee0940ca6cecd1972e25f07273a9.gif[/img]

With a campaign consisting of 10 tournaments, awesome and unique ships, great electronic music and last but not least - [b]VR, motion simulators and Steam Deck support![/b]

That's right, and you can grab your copy 10% off! Don't miss this chance and join the competition! We hope you will enjoy the new game and look forward for Dark Moon news coming soon:).

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761870
